Name: Em's SVE Animals (collection bundle)
Author: Rivalrabbit
Description:
New designs and colour options for each [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]SVE[/url] animal
A collection bundle of Em's SVE [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36100]bears[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36534]geese[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36181]camels[/url]
Including the animals, their produce and Marnie's livestock icons
Available for Content Patcher and Alternative textures
Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29997]Livestock Bazaar[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/W1HQ4bKW/CP.png[/img]

Download and install the latest [url=https://smapi.io///]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher
[/url]Download and unzip "Em's SVE Animals CP"
Move the folder to \Stardew Valley\Mods\
Enjoy!

When buying a bear, camel or goose from Marnie, their type gets randomised
If you rather choose which type you get, you can use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29997]Livestock Bazaar
[/url]
Alternatively, you can choose ﻿"Em's SVE Animals CP [b]Config[/b]"
This allows you to choose one type of bear, camel and goose for your farm with a config.json

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/RZ8TM2cp/Honey-Config.png[/img]

To change the defaults or disable an item:
Open the [i]config.json[/i] file in the mod folder
Replace the "[color=#e69138]Default[/color]" with the type you like
Or replace "[color=#e69138]true[/color]" with "[color=#e69138]false[/color]"
Save and close the folder again, and you're all set!
Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/MGb2cDyd/Patchnotes.png[/img]

[i]Update 1.1 Resolved missing files and script issues in CP file
Update 1.2 Compatible with livestock bazaar, multiple new animal types, animation improvements[/i]
